svg.title: Margin, co-margin and the surrogate band
svg.desc: Left: a wavy decision boundary x2 = 0.6 sin(1.6 x1) splits the plane into a +1 region above and a -1 region below. For one point x the margin h_f(x) is the radius of the largest disc around x that stays inside its own class; it touches the boundary. A smaller green disc of radius |g(x)|/L(g) sits inside it: the co-margin lower bound. A grey band of half-width gamma around the boundary marks where the surrogate classifier differs from f. Right: sgn(t), the ramp sgn_gamma(t), and the tent |sgn(t) - sgn_gamma(t)|, which is continuous although sgn jumps.
svg.text: Three distances from x to the decision boundary
f = sgn∘g with g(x) = x2 − 0.6·sin(1.6·x1), whose Lipschitz constant is L(g) = √(1 + 0.96²) ≈ 1.39
margin h_f(x) = 0.91: to the nearest flip
disc of radius h_f(x): one class only
The surrogate, in the score t = g(x)
